ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: I chose Avocet because this is a creative, open-ended task (arranging/sequencing songs into a soundtrack), and Avocet has the clearly higher Creative Generation eval score (82.7 vs 78.8) — the only capability gap that exceeds the 2.0-point variance threshold between the two models. I weighted measured capability over self-reported task preference, since the documentation explicitly notes that preference does not correlate with output quality (Avocet rates this its least-preferred family yet performs best on it).
